newsitem.title: MEXICO: Posadas up sharply on partnership hopes.
newsitem.headline: Posadas up sharply on partnership hopes.

text.p: Shares listed by Mexican hotel operator Posadas were sharply up in late trade on the bourse on specuulation about a forthcoming joint venture, dealers said.
Posadas A class shares were near the head the promimnent gainers' list, rising 23 centavos to 3.83 pesos, while the L class was up 19 centavos at 3.85 pesos.
"The word is they will go into partnership with Ece Corporation to build hotels and restaurants," a floor trader said. Said another: "It's moving very quickly, there are several rooms on the floor."

Other dealers said the source for speculation was a business column in the local daily El Financiero saying Posadas was interested in building a hotel in a Mexico City race track coming up for auction.
Neither Posadas nor Ece were available for comment.
